jobs.label: むわ～
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original Japanese manga lettering overlay, exact text (verbatim): "むわ～". This represents humid summer heat lingering in the air, for an everyday warm room or post-exercise scene. Only these three glyphs: む, わ, ～. Hand-drawn rounded Japanese brush lettering, organic varying stroke width, gently sagging and wavy horizontal baseline, the long wave trailing to the right. Warm muted mauve-brown ink with a narrow creamy-white outline for legibility over illustrations. Large well-spaced readable characters, flat 2D drawn texture. Isolated typography only, centered with generous transparent margins. True transparent PNG, no paper, no frame, no gradient background, no fog, no steam, no characters, no hearts, no watermark. Do not reproduce any specific existing lettering asset.

jobs.label: どきっ

Original expressive hand-drawn Japanese lettering, lively thick-to-thin strokes, gently rising diagonal composition. Muted raspberry-pink ink, slim cream-white border, a tiny offset darker pink edge for readability, flat 2D ink look. Each glyph clearly legible. Typography only, centered with generous margins. jobs.label: 薄い熱気
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one subtle overlay of humid warm air for a 2D anime scene on a truly transparent background. A wide sparse veil of very faint warm ivory vapor, translucent wispy filaments and broad barely visible soft curls drifting upward, smoothly feathered into fully transparent empty space. Airy uneven diffuse mist, not opaque smoke and not solid cartoon cloud puffs. Most of the canvas remains empty and fully transparent; vapor opacity is low so a background illustration can remain visible through it. No objects, no people, no letters, no hearts, no frame, no solid background, no checkerboard pixels. A single independent atmosphere layer, all-ages everyday humidity effect.
